notes.title: We're Joining The Days of Ramadan Festival 2025!
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

Get ready! We're thrilled to announce that we'll be participating in the 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival, running from February 28th at 02:00 GMT+8 to March 31st, 2025, at 02:00 GMT+8!

The 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival marks a first-of-its-kind event, bringing together indie game developers from around the globe for a Ramadan-themed sale. It's a fantastic opportunity for indie devs and game lovers to connect, share ideas, and celebrate Ramadan together.

During the festival, feel free to check out and play the latest games and grab some awesome discounts from across Asia! We hope you have a blast!

notes.title: 🐈 We're participating in the Women's Indie Game Showcase, meow~
notes.content:
Hello, Player! ːSpeech_Loveː

Hehe, we’re a bit excited about our first launch on Steam! ːsteammockingː

As you can see, we are participating in the Women's Indie Game Showcase, and we owe a big thanks to our amazing artist for creating so many adorable characters and animations!

We will be showcasing alongside over sixty games from November 13 to 25 (Beijing time), and the event will be live-streamed on the GETWIGI Twitch channel! We'll also be featured on Steam's online event page, so we hope you'll add us to your wishlist! ːSpeech_Loveː

We’ll be starting PlayTest sessions soon, so keep an eye out for updates if you're interested!

See you next time!
